title: SLIME SPELL
oneLiner: Blast bouncing dungeon slimes before they swarm the wizard!
mechanics: Move the wizard around one dungeon screen.
Press A to fire magical bolts at slimes.
Slimes split into smaller blobs when blasted.
Survive and destroy slimes to score; more appear over time.
lose: The wizard loses all hearts after touching slimes.
scoring: Earn points for blasting slimes, with bonus points for smaller blobs.
